claim: Patchline runs a disaster recovery exercise over live generated artifacts instead of a paper checklist: it rebuilds the public corpus release, hosted docs site, artifact release manifest, and signed certificate revocation log; publishes each component to two checksum-covered mirrors; corrupts or deletes primary-mirror copies for three components; restores every component from the first mirror whose full file manifest verifies; replays the restored certificate log; and rejects a negative control where every mirror has lost the required certificate-log bundle. This proves the public corpus, docs, releases, and certificate logs are restorable from mirrors with checksum failover and explicit unrecoverable-failure detection.
real_repo: patchline (self): mirror restore over generated corpus, docs, release, and certificate artifacts

components.description: Signed public corpus release rebuilt from the existing corpus release gate.
Hosted documentation site with generated public-demo evidence.
Deterministic artifact DOI/release manifest with refs, archives, checksums, and command versions.
Signed certificate revocation replay bundle plus hardware-signing certificate log.
